info.name: Online Examination System API
info.description: Run order: `npm run seed`, `npm start`, then run this collection top to bottom (Runner / newman).

exec: pm.test("returns access + refresh token", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.accessToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(d.refreshToken).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Refresh with spent token (401) - reuse detected

exec: const g = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.name === "CSE-A"); pm.collectionVariables.set("groupAId", g._id);

item.name: Student cannot read answer key via question API (403)

request.description: Pre-request sets startIso/endIso relative to now.

item.name: Delete question used in published exam (409)

exec: pm.test("exam listed, no questions leaked", () => { const e = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("examId")); pm.expect(e).to.exist; pm.expect(e.questions).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: Start attempt (201) - no answer key in payload
Save answers - option from other question (400)
Start second attempt on single-attempt exam (409)

exec: pm.test("results not released", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.resultsReleased).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.score).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: Release results while exam is open (409)

exec: pm.test("aggregations present", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.summary.students).to.eql(8); pm.expect(d.questionWise.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d.sectionWise.length).to.eql(2); });
